hook: Ostariophysan fish history fits a network with four hybridization events better than a simple tree.
summary: The authors built a way to measure support for branches in evolutionary networks and applied it to the large group of fishes including carp and catfish. A tree was not the best model, and a network with four reticulation events fit best, though their placement was uncertain. They also ran a first, simple biogeographic reconstruction on a network, which they describe as a starting point only.
title: Beyond tree-like evolution in ostariophysan fishes
